title: Group strings by character similarity
answer: A common interpretation of character similarity is anagram grouping. Normalize each String to a canonical key by converting it to a character array, sorting the characters, and rebuilding a String key. Then group original values by that key in a Map. AeroTopo's `anagrams` method uses `Collectors.groupingBy`, a `LinkedHashMap`, and the sorted-character key so encounter order of groups remains predictable. For n strings of maximum length k, sorting each key gives roughly O(n · k log k) time.
